201041756_9dce8a8e.text: In acute hippocampal brain slices, we identified OLM neurons based on tdTomato expression using the Htr3a‐Cre::Ai14 and Sst‐Cre::Ai14 transgenic lines. Single cells were electrophysiologically characterized, and their cytosolic mRNA was subsequently aspirated. Single‐cell RNA sequencing was performed after confirming OLM identity by post hoc visualization of axons and dendrites.
